newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Huili Group gets 150 mln yuan loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Huili Group gets 150 mln yuan loan.

text.p: Shanghai Huili Group, the holding company of Shanghai Huili Building Materials Co, has obtained a 150 million yuan ($18 million), two-year loan from a state bank, company officials said.
"The loan agreement was signed on Wednesday," a company official said by telephone on Friday from the group's headquarters in Shanghai.
He did not give the terms of the loan.

The loan, extended by the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, would be used to finance a new floorboard processing line at a plant in which Shanghai Huili Building Materials has a 75 percent stake, a second official said.
Shanghai Huili Building Materials listed 80 million B shares, which are for foreign investors, on Shanghai's stock exchange last June, officials said.
